purpose: Construct the continuity kernel and lineage graph from normalized metadata and time-indexed snapshots.

lineage_graph.description: Directed graph showing structural evolution across snapshots.

transformations.description: List of structural changes (template, layout, substrate, navigation).

regime_shifts.description: Points where the object changes operational regime.

continuity_kernel.description: Stable structural elements preserved across versions.

lineage_concepts.continuity_kernel: Minimal set of structural elements that persist across snapshots.
lineage_concepts.transformations: Structural changes between snapshots: layout, navigation, template, substrate.
lineage_concepts.regime_shifts: Structural changes indicating a shift in operational regime.

procedure: Compare each snapshot pair for structural changes.
Detect regime shifts using substrate and template changes.
Extract continuity kernel across all snapshots.
Build lineage graph with nodes as snapshots and edges as transformations.
Emit outputs for COLLECTION_OPERATOR and PRESERVATION_OPERATOR.
guarantees: Regime shifts are based on structural change.
Continuity kernel is minimal and non-speculative.
Missing snapshots produce uncertainty, not assumptions.
